verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud documents a first-party MCP server: every project ships one, automatically configured for that project's data, and users connect AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Cursor by copying the MCP Server URL. A probe also confirms the official MCP server documentation page. Missing for 10: details of the exposed MCP tools and authentication, independent or hands-on corroboration, and availability beyond Orama Cloud (the open-source library is not shown to ship one).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Every Orama Cloud project comes with an MCP server that is automatically configured to interact with your project's data.
By copying the MCP Server URL, you can easily connect your Orama Cloud project to various AI assistants that support the MCP protocol.
you'll be able to interact with your data from different AI interfaces, including ChatGPT, Cursor, and many other.
